Constitutional Principles

Provenance-First

Every claim must be traceable to a source. Source facts, user claims, analyst interpretations, assumptions, projections, and unknowns are distinguished.

Immutable History

Historical research-run results are immutable. Rankings from prior tournaments remain as snapshots and are not retroactively changed by later preferences.

Explicit Uncertainty

The repository explicitly lists gaps, unverified material, and inaccessible sources. See the Completeness Audit for the full picture.

Evidence-Weighted Scoring

Scores incorporate evidence labels: verified claims score higher than analyst interpretations, which score higher than unsupported assumptions.

Research Sessions

The repository was built from multiple Deep Research sessions, each generating a ranked tournament round:

Reset 1–7 Early tournament rounds — partial transcripts available through recovery pass. Ranking results preserved as immutable snapshots.
Reset 8 Eighth Reset — most complete dataset. 50+ cited sources, full financial models, validation plans, and technical blueprints per canonical idea.
Collaborative Post-Reset 8 collaborative additions. New ideas added with full provenance. Pairwise voting introduced for group ranking.
